verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs say it lets you onboard new hires, offers employee self-service, and sends new-hire HR data straight into payroll. That shows a first-party onboarding capability, but nothing describes the actual self-serve flow or what it collects. Missing for 10: documented collection of W-4, I-9 and bank/direct-deposit details, a self-serve invite sent to the new hire before day one, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
